question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Arun has experienced severe mental and emotional turmoil, as well as interpersonal _________ at times.
solution:
The correct answer is "**numbness**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Among the given options, the correct word to fill the blank is "numbness."**
 
• **The word numbness completes the phrase "interpersonal numbness.**"
 
 
• "Interpersonal numbness" refers to a lack of emotional connection with others.(पारस्परिक स्तब्धता)
 
• This can be a symptom of mental health issues such as depression or anxiety.
 
 
 
• Numbness can also refer to physical sensations, such as a lack of feeling in a body part.(सुन्न होना)
 
• In this context, however, it is referring to emotional numbness.
 
• Thus, the correct sentence will be:
 
 
• Arun has experienced severe mental and emotional turmoil, as well as interpersonal numbness__ at times.
 
 

Hence, **the correct answer is option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Dizziness is a feeling of lightheadedness or unsteadiness.(चक्कर आना)
 
• Symptoms is a general term that could refer to any type of physical or mental manifestation.(लक्षण)
 
• Fatigue is a feeling of extreme tiredness or exhaustion.(थकान)
